ideas.pitch: A social network web application that forces users to caption and interact with automatically corrupted, glitched images generated live from mystery prompts.
ideas.problem_statement: Mystery Web Development Challenge: Transform a mystery challenge prompt into a creative, functional and presentable website under tight time constraints.
ideas.title: GlitchGram
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the 'Build. Break. Laugh.' theme directly with humor and visual interaction will charm the judges during the live 3-5 minute presentation.

ideas.pitch: An interactive real-time multiplayer browser game where the physics engine and game rules mutate dynamically based on elements parsed from the mystery hackathon challenge prompt.
ideas.problem_statement: Mystery Web Development Challenge: Receive a mystery challenge prompt at the beginning of the event and build a functional website within the allotted time.
ideas.title: PromptPong
ideas.why_it_could_win: A polished, working multiplayer game is always a massive crowd-pleaser and proves technical execution under pressure.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered web companion that aggressively critiques your code architecture and website design choices in real-time as you build your mystery challenge submission.
ideas.problem_statement: Mystery Web Development Challenge: Build a functional website within the allotted time, present your project, and answer questions about your implementation approach.
ideas.title: RoastMyPrompt
ideas.why_it_could_win: It targets a pain point every hackathon participant feels—debugging under time pressure—while leaning heavily into the 'Laugh' tagline of the event.

ideas.pitch: A live-updating, decentralized-feeling knowledge base that uses AI to dynamically rewrite its own articles based on incoming user submissions and the event's secret theme.
ideas.problem_statement: Mystery Web Development Challenge: Interpret the prompt, build something interesting, make it work, and be ready to explain your ideas.
ideas.title: ChaosWiki
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates rapid state management and creative AI integration, making for an entertaining live demo where judges can type queries on the spot.

ideas.pitch: An automated comic strip and status page generator that turns your messy git commit history and panic coding hours into a hilarious visual timeline for the final presentation.
ideas.problem_statement: Mystery Web Development Challenge: Submit the completed project and present your project to the judges, explaining your implementation and approach.
ideas.title: DevAlibi
ideas.why_it_could_win: Every single judge and team in the room relates to the 24-48 hour hackathon panic; presenting a tool that pokes fun at the journey guarantees laughs and memorability.
